preferred_rationale: Consistently stated by the operator, industry directories and press since at least 2025 as the current capacity of the operating facility; whether it is IT load or grid import is not specified.
notes: 24MW across c.8,000 sqm; Uptime Institute Tier III certified.

Operator markets the site as 'expandable to 40MW'; APRS associates the 40MW with the consented DV3/extension works ('planning to increase the site to 40MW', size defined in the environmental management plan for 25/01159/PPP). Not a decision-notice figure.
APRS states it 'believes' the existing site has a 24MW power connection — an interpretation of the operator's 24MW figure as grid import, not independently confirmed.
